blocks.title: Minimal working sketch
blocks.code:
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
X,y=load_iris(return_X_y=True)
Xtr,Xte,ytr,yte=train_test_split(X,y,random_state=0)
model=LogisticRegression(max_iter=200).fit(Xtr,ytr)
print(model.score(Xte,yte))

spans.text: Treat this as the smallest runnable shape, then add tracing, validation, and tests before production.
